text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm-hmm~♪ I think I'll spend the whole 
day relaxing and taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, Hishi Miracle. Fancy meeting you here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan. You're right~ Did you just get 
out of the bath?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I went freestyle running with the 
guys from my old team and got all dirty. I 
washed the sweat off, so I'm heading home 
now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're leaving already? Just after 
taking a bath? ...Pokke-chan, coming all 
the way to a super sento and only doing 
that is way too wasteful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There are so many healing spots at the 
super sento, though. What a waste. You've 
gotta get your money's worth out of the 
entry fee~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really that much of a shame...? 
Guess I'll stick around and play a bit 
more then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, first up is~, the bedrock 
bath! Let's warm up and sweat all the 
toxins right out.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A bedrock bath? If you wanna warm up, 
wouldn't a sauna do the trick?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Saunas are too hot. I came here to relax, 
so enduring torture goes against my 
principles.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's take it nice and slooow, 
and ease on into a relaxing detox♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I'm warming up, but isn't 
it kinda lukewarm? I'm just lying here, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Warm your front and back for 15 minutes 
each, then cool down. Repeat that for 3 
sets. The effects will gradually show~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh! Sweat's just pouring out now! It's 
dripping and won't stop!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I didn't know you could sweat this 
much! My body is going crazy!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! An open-air bath after sweating a 
ton is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm stuffed, absolutely stuffed! The 
food at super sentos is surprisingly good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's a hidden gourmet gem, you 
see. Though wow, Pokke-chan, you sure eat 
fast!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: They've even got manga! Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Dozing off while reading manga in the 
break room... and slipping into dreamland. 
It's pure bliss, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Blanket is ready to go. Now, let's relax~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...*pheeew*. Man... super public baths are 
the absolute best...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Right~? ...Huaah, I'm melting away...

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, well? If it isn't the former leader 
of 'L/Roars', Jungle Pocket!

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, are you kidding me?! Taking a 
carefree afternoon nap with that goofy 
look on your face! Seems like you've 
completely lost your fangs!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What, you guys from some other 
team or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? What!? A-A team...? I don't really 
get it, but this sounds super bad!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (That's it! I need to contact Trainer...!)

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Bring it on, you bastard! Step outside!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawawa. W-Wait... up! ...P-Please...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...E-Even without going outside, there's 
a way to settle this right here...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While relaxing at home on my day off, I 
received a message from Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dropping everything, I sprint to where she 
is. Praying that she's safe, I arrive at 
the destination, and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yay, all done~.

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Again?! What is up with that insane 
strength?! You're just sweeping the board 
all by yourself, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, about that. Hishi Miracle totally 
destroyed them at a kids' mahjong game, 
y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I play games all the time at the super 
sento to kill time. I'm crazy lucky today, 
though. Total hot streak~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. The losers obey the winner, 
right? Hishi Miracle, what's your demand 
for these guys?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, peacefully... Well, it's already not 
peaceful at all... Trainer, what should we 
do?
choice_data_list: Should we make them do a penalty game...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a penalty game... If it comes to 
that, it has to be *that*, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaa! Ow, owwwww--!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, pathetic, getting done in by a 
stupid acupressure mat. Something like 
this is... o-oww, that hurts, hey!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, once you get used to it, it hurts 
so good~. It's working like a charm~~~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...? Note to self: never pick a 
fight with Hishi Miracle at a super sento.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Massages usually cost extra, 
so I'm happy to get one for free!

text_block_list.name: Rival Team Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Is this amount of force alright?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Ahhh, pure bliss, pure paradise...♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Getting a massage while eating ice 
cream... I feel like the king of the super 
sento bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, We are most pleased~ ...Just 
kidding♪
